title: Nomad Procession salt-basin daylight panorama

processing: Source and runtime PNG are byte-identical. Runtime wraps longitude with a four-percent shader overlap, explicit texture gradients and filtered polar rows. No image editing or baked scene lighting was applied.

lighting.note: The source contains broad horizon glow, not a sharply located sun disk. The physical directional key supplies the approximately 23-degree sun elevation.
